Maya (People Ops): Hey everyone 11 quick follow-up from today's all-hands re: offsite + travel logistics. Opening a short Q&A focused on accessibility, family needs, and booking flexibility. I'll add answers to the Workstyle FAQ later. https://intranet.redwood/workstyle :heart:

Omar Hassan: Appreciate this. Question: I need a quiet workspace and a low-sensory room during the offsite week for neurodivergent needs. How do I request that?

Maya (People Ops): Please file an accommodation request via the Access form (link in the playbook). We can reserve a low-sensory room at the venue or arrange nearby coworking with private rooms. Mark "sensory-accommodation" on the form and we'll prioritize. No medical documentation required for initial requests, but we may follow up for logistics.

Leah Kim: For breastfeeding parents: will there be dedicated lactation rooms at the offsite? Also, can we get a small fridge in the room?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 lactation rooms will be available; we'll post locations before travel. Fridge requests are supported 1 include "lactation-fridge" on your accommodation form and we'll place a small fridge or ensure access to a locked fridge. If you need pumping insurance documentation for travel, DM and we'll provide a letter for airlines/hotels.

Priya Rao: If I need to bring my caregiver for medical reasons, is caregiver travel reimbursed? What's the process?

Maya (People Ops): Caregiver travel can be covered where medically necessary. Process: 1) Submit a People Ops request with manager approval and basic supporting note, 2) People Ops will confirm pre-approval and provide expense guidance. Tag expenses as `caregiver-travel`. We'll handle sensitive details privately.

AccessibilityBot: Notice: Accessibility accommodations requested within 14 days of travel may have limited options. Early requests strongly recommended. See: https://intranet.redwood/accessibility (automated).

Omar Hassan: Travel booking 1 if I need a wheelchair-accessible hotel room, should I book via Travel Portal or request People Ops to book it for me?

Maya (People Ops): If you know the requirement up-front, ask People Ops to book so we can confirm accessible room types with the hotel. If you book through the Travel Portal, please DM us immediately so we can verify the room meets accessibility needs and arrange refunds/changes if not.

Leah Kim: Any different per-diem or lodging caps if I require a more accessible room that costs more?

Maya (People Ops): Yes 1 we allow exceptions for accessibility-related costs. Indicate `accessibility-exception` on the expense and attach the accommodation confirmation. No manager pre-approval needed; People Ops will review and approve.

Priya Rao: Desk booking 1 can I request a desk near an elevator or an ergonomic chair reserved for the quarter?

Maya (People Ops): You can request proximity holds for accessibility reasons. Use Office Booking -> Accessibility Holds or submit the Access form. Ergonomic equipment requests are handled by Workplace and shipped or reserved in-hub. Tag any equipment expenses `ergonomic`.

Maya (People Ops): Example short copy for expenses or pre-approvals:

```
Expense title: Offsite-AccessibleRoom-July
Amount: 420.00
Category: Lodging - Accessible Room
Receipts: hotel_accessible.pdf
Tag: accessibility-exception
```

Maya (People Ops): Thanks for raising these 1 I'll update the FAQ and ping folks who submitted forms. If you need confidential help, DM me or email people-ops@redwood.com. We'll keep accommodation discussions private and supportive. :handshake:
